ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster Capacity Breakdown
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster CPU, memory, and storage capacity breakdown using the demand model (OnlineCapacityAnalytics). One row per ClusterComputeResource, sorted ascending by overall capacity-remaining percentage so the most-constrained cluster floats to the top. Acts as the primary selector in the Fleet Capacity & Rightsizing dashboard (Band B).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster Capacity Overview
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster capacity assessment, shows post-HA free capacity percentages, days-until-runout projections from VCF Ops capacity analytics, and 'how many more VMs fit' counts for both CPU and memory. Drives the capacity assessment section of the Capacity Assessment & Right-Sizing dashboard. Use the color thresholds to scan for at-risk clusters before reading numbers.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster Demand & Capacity Overview v2
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster demand and capacity overview for v2 demand-driven capacity planning dashboard. Percentages first (demand %, contention % avg and P95), then usable-vs-provisioned CPU comparison in GHz, then memory demand and capacity in auto-units. Drives row selection to downstream VM contention, host outlier, and vSAN detail views. Default sort: CPU Contention P95 descending (worst first).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster Quarterly CPU & Memory Demand
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster CPU and memory demand statistics over a 90-day rolling window for quarterly executive capacity review. Columns cover average, maximum, and 95th percentile demand for both CPU and memory. All threshold columns colour higher-is-worse (ascending_range: false). Default sort by CPU Demand P95 descending should be applied in the dashboard widget that references this view.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster Storage Trend
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster storage utilization trend for quarterly executive capacity review. Columns cover current total capacity, current used space, disk usage percentage (super metric, thresholded), 90-day average and maximum used space, and current provisioned space. The 90-day time window matches the quarterly review scope; AVG and MAX columns aggregate over that full window. Color thresholds on the disk usage percentage column flag clusters approaching capacity limits.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Cluster VM Count Overview
ViewDef.Description: Per-cluster VM count statistics over a 90-day rolling window for quarterly executive capacity review. Columns show current running and total VM counts, plus Avg/Max/P5 running VM counts over the window to signal population stability (Avg close to Max = stable; Avg >> P5 = significant churn). Note: MIN is not a supported VCF Ops view transformation; P5 (5th percentile) is used instead as a low-water-mark proxy over the 90-day window. Running Hosts (Current) provides the denominator for VMs-per-host calculations in the dashboard. No thresholds applied, this view is a raw-count reference used alongside the MetricChart widget that renders the actual timeline per cluster.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] CPU Support Status by Cluster
ViewDef.Description: Worst CPU support tier among each cluster's hosts per Broadcom KB 318697: 0=all supported, 1=deprecated, 2=discontinued starting from VCF 9.2, 3=discontinued, 4=unsupported (pre-9.0, not in KB 318697 scope). Drives the host-level view in the CPU Support Status dashboard.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] CPU Support Status by Host
ViewDef.Description: Per-host CPU support tier per Broadcom KB 318697: 0=supported, 1=deprecated, 2=discontinued starting from VCF 9.2, 3=discontinued, 4=unsupported (pre-9.0, not in KB 318697 scope). Unlisted CPUs read 0 (supported) by design. Subject is HostSystem (VMWARE adapter). Columns: physical host model, physical CPU model, and the coded support-tier super metric (color-thresholded). Resource name is rendered automatically as the leftmost column by the list widget, no explicit name column is declared here. Designed to receive a ClusterComputeResource resourceId interaction from an upstream cluster scope-selection widget (the consuming dashboard wires that interaction so rows are scoped to the selected cluster's descendant hosts); see content/views/host_contention_outliers.yaml for the same convention.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Datastore Reclaimable Space
ViewDef.Description: Per-datastore capacity and reclaimable-space list. Columns cover total capacity, used percentage, free space, snapshot space consumed, and orphaned-disk space, the two primary rightsizing reclaim buckets. All capacity metrics are KB-native in the VMWARE adapter; unit: "gb" instructs the renderer to emit preferredUnitId="gb" so VCF Ops converts natively. Sort by Snapshot Space descending (largest snapshot consumers first), apply at the dashboard widget level. Part of the Fleet Capacity & Rightsizing dashboard (Band E).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Host Contention Outliers
ViewDef.Description: Per-host CPU and memory contention outlier view for demand-driven capacity planning dashboards. Subject is HostSystem; intended to receive a ClusterComputeResource resourceId interaction from an upstream cluster overview widget (the consuming dashboard wires that interaction so rows are scoped to the selected cluster's descendant hosts). Columns surface the signals that identify which hosts are outliers, where VMs are starving for CPU or memory is contended compared to cluster peers, over a 24-hour window. Purely built-in VMWARE adapter metrics; no super metric columns.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Per-Host vSAN Contribution
ViewDef.Description: Per-host vSAN client-side performance detail view for demand-driven capacity planning dashboards. Subject is HostSystem (VMWARE adapter); metrics come from the vSAN DOM client telemetry path (vsan|performance|domClient|*), which measures front-end read/write IOPS, latency, and congestion as seen by each host acting as a vSAN client. Use alongside cluster-level vSAN views to identify hosts that are outliers in latency or IOPS compared to cluster peers. Purely built-in VMWARE adapter metrics; no super metric columns.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Oversized VMs, Reclaimable
ViewDef.Description: Per-VM reclaimable-resource list for oversized virtual machines. Shows the parent cluster, vCPUs to remove, and memory to reclaim (KB source, displayed in GB) for each VM flagged oversized by the VCF Ops capacity engine (summary|oversized == 1). Intended as Band D-1 of the Fleet Capacity & Rightsizing dashboard; receives ClusterComputeResource resourceId from the upstream cluster-selector widget to scope the list to the selected cluster. Sort by vCPUs to Remove descending (biggest reclaim first), apply at the dashboard widget level (sort_by_column: "vCPUs to Remove", sort_by_dir: desc); view-level default sort is not a loader-supported field.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Undersized VMs, Add Resources
ViewDef.Description: Per-VM resource-addition list for undersized virtual machines. Shows the parent cluster, vCPUs to add, and memory to add (KB source, displayed in GB) for each VM flagged undersized by the VCF Ops capacity engine (summary|undersized == 1). Intended as Band D-2 of the Fleet Capacity & Rightsizing dashboard; receives ClusterComputeResource resourceId from the upstream cluster-selector widget to scope the list to the selected cluster. Sort by vCPUs to Add descending (largest need first), apply at the dashboard widget level (sort_by_column: "vCPUs to Add", sort_by_dir: desc); view-level default sort is not a loader-supported field. View will be empty until at least one VM is flagged undersized; this is expected (recon confirmed 0 undersized VMs at authoring time).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Automation Consumption Trend
ViewDef.Description: 12-week Automation consumption pattern (licensed cores, managed hosts, managed VM count) with a 90-day forecast. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind CASAdapter / resource_kind CAS World; 0 CASAdapter resources on ro818 today, structural only until a lab has a registered Automation cloud account). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (Automation Consumption Trend).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] Automation Licensing by Month
ViewDef.Description: Month-by-month Automation-managed host count and licensed cores, one row per month over the trailing year. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind CASAdapter / resource_kind CAS World; 0 CASAdapter resources on ro818 today, structural only until a lab has a registered Automation cloud account). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (Automation Licensing Overtime).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] NSX Consumption Trend
ViewDef.Description: 12-week NSX consumption pattern (licensed cores, prepared hosts, logical segment count) with a 90-day forecast. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind NSXTAdapter / resource_kind NSXT World; segment count is 0.0 on ro818 today, structural only until a lab has real NSX segments). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (NSX Consumption Trend).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] NSX Licensing by Month
ViewDef.Description: Month-by-month NSX prepared host count and licensed cores, one row per month over the trailing year. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind NSXTAdapter / resource_kind NSXT World; 0 TransportNode objects on ro818 today, structural only until a lab has real NSX transport nodes). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (NSX Licensing Overtime).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VCF License Usage Trend
ViewDef.Description: 12-week trend of consumed VCF cores with a 90-day forecast. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind VMWARE_INFRA_HEALTH / resource_kind LICENSE_USAGE_WORLD). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (VCF License Usage Over Time).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VCF Licensing by Month
ViewDef.Description: Month-by-month VCF and vSAN license usage vs capacity, one row per month over the trailing year, for reconciling license position with Broadcom. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind VMWARE_INFRA_HEALTH / resource_kind LICENSE_USAGE_WORLD). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (VCF Licensing Overtime).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] vSAN License Usage Trend
ViewDef.Description: 12-week trend of consumed vSAN TiB with a 90-day forecast. Targets VCF Operations 8.x (validated against Aria Operations 8.18.7 recon, adapter_kind VMWARE_INFRA_HEALTH / resource_kind LICENSE_USAGE_WORLD). Rebuilt from Scott's public "VCF Consumption Overview v2" community content (vSAN Usage Overtime).

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VKS Core Consumption by vCenter
ViewDef.Description: One row per vCenter. Columns match the PowerShell VKS core consumption script output exactly: Total VM vCPU, VKS vCPU (all node image VMs, CP+Worker), Supervisor vCPU, Pod vCPU, VM Service vCPU, Regular vCPU, vCLS vCPU, Physical Cores, Global Ratio, and Calculated VKS Cores.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VM Contention v2
ViewDef.Description: Per-VM CPU and memory contention with storage latency for v2 demand-driven capacity planning dashboard. Replaces v1's balloon/swap columns with read/write latency. Receives ClusterComputeResource resourceId from upstream cluster overview widget. CPU contention (Ready avg + P95, Co-Stop P95), memory contention avg, and storage latency (read + write avg). Default sort: CPU Ready P95 descending (worst first). Purely built-in VMWARE adapter metrics; no super metric columns.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VM Right-Sizing Candidates
ViewDef.Description: Per-VM right-sizing candidate list, shows VCF Ops's oversized/undersized/idle flags, current vCPU + memory allocations, recommended target sizes (from companion target-size super metrics), and 95th-percentile demand-based justification columns for the resize decision. Oversized/undersized/idle flags are colored red when set (value=1). CPU Demand P95 and Mem Usage P95 are colored green <50% / yellow 50-60% / orange 60-90% / red >90%, using a 1-month lookback window. Use with the '[VCF Content Factory] VMs - Right-Sizing Candidates' dynamic custom group as the widget scope to filter down to flagged VMs only. Drives the right-sizing section of the Capacity Assessment & Right-Sizing dashboard.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] VM Snapshot Inventory
ViewDef.Description: Per-snapshot inventory for VMWARE Virtual Machines: one row per snapshot instance (GROUP_diskspace fan-out), with Snapshot Name, Age (Days), Snapshot Space (GB), Creator, Description, plus flat Parent Cluster, Parent vCenter, Parent Datastore, and Total Snapshot Space (GB). One row per LIVE snapshot older than 24h, the instanced-key subject filter below drops ghost/deleted-snapshot rows per-row. Instanced properties populate ~24h after snapshot creation; Age -1 = deleted or <24h old, so snapshots younger than 24h don't appear, a recall gap, not a bug. Sort descending on Age (or Total Snapshot Space (GB) as a proxy) at the consuming widget (sort_by_column/sort_by_dir); no view-level default. Creator/Description render blank until diskspace|snapshot|{creator,description} are enabled on the Default Policy (disabled by default), a separate operator action. Full narrative: knowledge/designs/views/vm-snapshot-inventory.md

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] vSAN Cluster Health & Resync
ViewDef.Description: vSAN cluster health and resync state detail view for demand-driven capacity planning dashboards. Shows 24-hour average and current health scores, current resync backlog (bytes and object count), and raw used/total disk space. Subject is VirtualSANDCCluster (VirtualAndPhysicalSANAdapter), identical to vsan_cluster_performance.yaml. Intended as a detail-pane view driven by an upstream cluster picker; one or a few rows are expected in normal use.

ViewDef.Title: [VCF Content Factory] vSAN Cluster Performance
ViewDef.Description: Front-end vSAN performance detail view for demand-driven capacity planning dashboards. Shows 24-hour average IOPS (read, write, total), P95 read and write latency, and average congestion for the selected VirtualSANDCCluster object. Intended as a detail-pane view fed by an upstream ClusterComputeResource picker via a resourceId widget interaction; the dashboard author is responsible for kind-bridging between ClusterComputeResource and VirtualSANDCCluster (shared cluster name) at the widget level. One or a few rows are expected in normal use.
